body.name: Chronological local-alternative sampling law
body.construction: For each fixed \(B_n\), \(h\in H\cup\{0\}\), and \(\rho\in I\), generate outcomes from \(Y^{(h)}(0)=B\) and \(Y^{(h)}(1)=B+h_s/\sqrt n\), then execute \(\mathrm{def{:}sequential\mbox{-}design}\); the resulting probability kernel is \(\mathsf P_n^{h,\rho}\).
